skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-meta-conversions-api
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to connect a Cloudflare storefront to the Meta Conversions API without a store plugin. Configure consent and verify server-side purchase delivery with a test order.
skill.summary: Set up and verify consent-aware Meta purchase tracking on a Cloudflare storefront.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most flags are Markdown, vendor links, or routine setup instructions rather than shell substitution or system reconnaissance. Agent writes, order reads, and an unpinned installer present concrete risks. The instructions also expose credentials to agent tools, request unscoped permission approval, and leave consent unverified before enabling delivery.

remediation.issue: The workflow instructs assistants to request and pass the Meta access token.
remediation.suggestion: Require direct token entry in the Product Metrics app. Remove assistant token requests and keep credentials out of command arguments, tool calls, and traces.

remediation.issue: Cloudflare troubleshooting tells users to approve every permission.
remediation.suggestion: List and explain each required permission. Ask the admin to verify the account, zone, and permission scope before authorizing the gateway.

remediation.issue: Meta sending is enabled before the workflow verifies consent.
remediation.suggestion: Keep sending off until the merchant confirms data sharing and tests both granted and denied consent. Document the payload fields and consent required for each.

remediation.issue: Agent writes and order lookups lack explicit action and data boundaries.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the workspace, property, and intended change before writing. Prefer an explicitly selected test order and return only the delivery details needed for verification.

remediation.issue: The installer command does not pin the runner or the skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed installer version and an immutable skill revision. Document how to verify their provenance before running the installer.

content.user_title: Set Up Meta Conversions API on Cloudflare
content.value_statement: Browser-only tracking can miss storefront purchases. This skill guides you through Product Metrics setup, consent configuration, and server-side delivery checks in Meta Events Manager.
actual_capabilities: Check setup status through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP and identify unfinished steps.
Guide a workspace admin through connecting a proxied storefront and linking it to a Product Metrics property.
Explain how to connect the Meta pixel and select the storefront's supported consent banner.
Guide test order verification using Product Metrics and Meta Events Manager.
Explain how to create custom conversions and interpret missing profit or lifetime value events.
Explain how event names and IDs prevent duplicate counting when the browser pixel remains active.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, and access to the correct Cloudflare zone and Meta pixel.
Cloudflare authorization and Meta Events Manager actions require a person with the appropriate permissions.
Cloudflare Tracking uses orders reported by the confirmation page. It does not import historical orders, and later refunds do not revise Meta events.
This skill does not configure campaign bidding or provide a separate Advanced Matching setup.

use_cases.title: Connect a storefront without a store plugin
use_cases.description: Identify what you need to connect a Cloudflare storefront to a Product Metrics property and a Meta pixel.

use_cases.title: Investigate missing Meta purchases
use_cases.description: Compare a test order in Product Metrics with its delivery in Events Manager before changing campaign settings.

use_cases.title: Verify consent and pixel deduplication
use_cases.description: Check the consent banner and compare browser and server event IDs before enabling production delivery.

prompt_templates.title: List setup prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: What access, accounts, and consent settings do I need to connect my Cloudflare storefront to Meta through Product Metrics? Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Check setup progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my approved Product Metrics property. Tell me what is complete and which browser steps I need to finish.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a missing test purchase
prompt_templates.scenario: A test purchase does not appear in Events Manager
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me trace one test order from the confirmation page to Meta Test Events. Check the banner, destination status, and test event code.

prompt_templates.title: Plan consent and deduplication tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Validating a storefront that keeps the browser pixel
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan granted and denied consent tests for my storefront. Explain how to check matching purchase event IDs across browser and server. Do not enable sending.

output_examples.input: What do I still need to do if my website is linked but the gateway is not connected?
output: Your storefront is linked to the Product Metrics property.
A workspace admin must approve Product Metrics in Cloudflare and select the matching account and zone.
Verify the requested permissions before approving. Then check for Gateway setup complete.

output_examples.input: Why does my purchase appear in Test Events but not in reporting?
output: Test events verify delivery but do not count in reporting.
Check whether the Meta destination still has a test event code.
Once verification is complete, clear the code when you are ready for live reporting.

best_practices: Verify the Cloudflare zone, requested permissions, Product Metrics property, and Meta pixel before enabling the integration.
Enter the Meta access token directly in the Product Metrics app.
Test both granted and denied consent before enabling live sending. Clear the test event code before checking live reports.
anti_patterns: Sharing a Meta access token in chat or in command arguments.
Assuming that consent granted in one test proves that events are suppressed after consent is denied.
Treating a test event as a live conversion or expecting a refund to revise an event already sent to Meta.

faq.question: Do I need a store plugin or website code changes?
faq.answer: The basic setup uses a Cloudflare gateway, not a store plugin. It requires a proxied DNS record and an administrator who can approve the integration.

faq.question: Where should I enter the Meta access token?
faq.answer: Enter it in the Meta destination form in Product Metrics. Keep it out of assistant chats and tool arguments.

faq.question: Which consent banners are supported?
faq.answer: The guide lists OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, and Osano. Meta delivery requires permission to share ad user data, and custom events also require analytics consent.

faq.question: Can I keep the browser Meta pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. Meta deduplicates events when the browser and server send the same event name and ID within 48 hours.

faq.question: Why is the profit event missing?
faq.answer: Profit events need a complete contribution margin. Set a fallback product cost percentage and add applicable costs, then check a new test order.

faq.question: Are past orders or later refunds sent to Meta?
faq.answer: Product Metrics does not import past orders for Meta. Later refunds and cancellations do not revise events already sent.
